name: Claude Exec
description: Run claude --print through a Guardrail-managed wrapper with inline prompt text, input_files prompt context, working-directory control, and structured flag wiring.

guardrail_repo.description: Path to the Guardrail checkout that contains the Claude wrapper helper

prompt.description: Inline prompt text to send to Claude. Use this for per-run instructions; keep stable file-backed context in input_files.

input_files.description: One or more relative file paths resolved from working_dir. The wrapper reads their contents and injects them into Claude's prompt payload as tagged <input_file> blocks. Repeat --input input_files=... to pass multiple files. There is no separate prompt_file input.

mode.description: Permission mode governing tool approval behavior

max_budget_usd.description: Maximum dollar spend for this invocation (e.g. '1.00')

allowed_tools.description: Allowed tool list passed to Claude via --allowed-tools

system_prompt.description: Prompt appended to Claude's default system prompt. This is inline text only; there is no system_prompt_file input. Use review_each_time because wording changes execution behavior.

working_dir.description: Relative directory Claude should use as its process cwd. input_files are resolved from this directory.

add_dirs.description: Additional relative directories to grant Claude tool access to

session_name.description: Session slot identifier used by the Guardrail agent-session contract. This value keys the stored session-contract file and bounds continue/attach lifecycle operations.

no_session_persistence.description: Disable Claude session persistence. Default true. Guardrail lifecycle/session_id inputs remain Guardrail-side session-contract metadata and do not by themselves rehydrate Claude conversation state.

lifecycle.description: Session lifecycle intent: start a fresh named session, continue an existing one, or attach to a previously named session. Defaults to 'start'.

session_id.description: Machine-readable session identifier. Optional for 'start'; required for 'continue' and 'attach' if the approved session contract has one.

steps.description: Build the prompt from inline text and input_files, then run Claude CLI with structured arguments only

constraints: input_files are limited to approved relative paths and content-hash bound at approval time
working_dir controls the Claude process cwd; add_dirs only grants additional tool access
Guardrail does not provide outer sandboxing for Claude itself; running this recipe outside an external sandbox uses host privileges subject to Claude's own permission model
No shell mode steps — a single structured node wrapper handles prompt assembly and invocation
invariants: At least one prompt source must be present before Claude runs
Every declared operational input is wired through the wrapper
Output is non-empty (validator enforces .+ on response)
